system.description:
LEVEL 3

Inspiring Presence. Whichever ally is nearest to you has advantage (if multiple are equally close, choose your favorite).

LEVEL 7

Fire in my Bones. Your Songweaver's Inspiration also grants your target 1 additional action.

LEVEL 11

Unfailing Resolve. Your Songweaver's Inspiration allows your target to reroll with advantage or increases a die face by +2.

LEVEL 15

Chorus of Champions. (1/encounter) Free Reaction: Give all party members 1 action.
